verdict.rationale: GoDaddy is a domain-registrar and commerce API platform, not an AI agent or assistant host, so acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools is the wrong axis for this product. The evidence shows only the opposite role: GoDaddy publishes its own MCP server and an agent skill that external AI agents use. That is server-side capability and does not make this client story applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
